input.quote: unless terminated by either Party hereto upon ninety (90) days written notice to the other.
input.rationale: We do have a convenience right, but only on 90 days' notice and — critically — it triggers the Section 4.2 Termination Payment, so our exit is penalised, while HDI may walk away on the same 90 days' notice at any renewal point. We reduced our notice to 30 days without penalty and confined HDI's convenience right to the end of a term; the penalty itself is addressed under the liquidated-damages rule.

input.quote: This Agreement shall be automatically renewed for an additional one year period on each anniversary of the Effective Date, unless terminated by either Party hereto upon ninety (90) days written notice to the other.
input.rationale: Renewal is automatic for 12-month terms, but the non-renewal window is 90 days — at the outer edge of our walk-away line — with no reminder from HDI. Renewal terms and pricing (30% revenue share) are otherwise acceptable. We added a 30-day opt-out right for us and a 60-day pre-renewal reminder from HDI, with no charge for non-renewal.
